goal: Extract the cohesive item spawning API from Misc to substantially reduce the number of public methods and isolate Bukkit item-spawn and event-handling complexity.

inputs: com.gmail.nossr50.util.Misc.spawnItemsTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, int, double, ItemSpawnReason)
ops.details: Create ItemSpawnUtil in the same package and move the item spawning overloads and their shared implementation into it. Preserve public static signatures and behavior, including McMMOItemSpawnEvent cancellation, Material.AIR checks, nullable Player handling, natural versus direct drops, collection filtering, quantity handling, and velocity calculation. Keep all required Bukkit, ItemSpawnReason, McMMOItemSpawnEvent, and mcMMO dependencies in the extracted class.

inputs: com.gmail.nossr50.util.Misc.spawnItemsTowardsLocation(Player, Location, Location, ItemStack, int, double, ItemSpawnReason)
ops.details: Replace references to the moved Misc item-spawning methods with ItemSpawnUtil references. Preserve overload resolution and argument ordering at every caller.
Add com.gmail.nossr50.util.ItemSpawnUtil imports in callers that require them and remove imports made obsolete by the extraction.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
